mentions.name: Bastion
mentions.description: A native macOS app that runs each MCP server once for every client on the Mac, storing credentials in the Keychain and logging every call.
mentions.problem: MCP servers need per-client isolation with secure credential storage and a log of every call.
mentions.source_excerpt: Bastion - (https://bastion.mgcrea.io/), which runs each MCP server once for every client on the Mac, with credentials in the Keychain and every call logged.
